description: The bar chart illustrates the Macro F-score for two different methods, RECA and another method, across three frequency categories: High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the Macro F-score, which ranges from 0 to 1, and the horizontal axis categorizes the frequency of occurrences. The RECA method is represented by the orange bars, while the other method is represented by the gray bars. In the High frequency category, the RECA method has a Macro F-score of 0.837, and the other method has a score of 0.877. In the Medium frequency category, the RECA method has a score of 0.538, and the other method has a score of 0.609. In the Low frequency category, the RECA method has a score of 0.114, and the other method has a score of 0.224. The bars are sorted in descending order of frequency, with the High frequency category having the highest Macro F-score and the Low frequency category having the lowest. The chart does not include any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding on the bars.
